posts.author: John Klayer
posts.content_md: After reading the opinions in the 1/2 wave plate discussion about reflections going back into the laser from the wave plate I'm starting to worry about other components too. My main concern is the shutter I have within a 1/2 inch of the laser. The shutter is made from a meter movement with a diffusely reflecting aluminum disk blocking the beam. Is the diffuse reflection back into my C315 a concern? So far I haven't noticed any problems. I'm thinking of setting my cube beamsplitter off axis too.

posts.author: Johnfp
posts.content_md: If you're not noticing any problems, why change anything? Just be mindful in the future when you set your optics to see where the back reflections go.

posts.author: holorefugee
posts.content_md:
I can't make my C315 jump modes. My diodes are another story and I run the beam the length of the table to a 12mm mirror at 45deg. This and slightly tilting all optics keeps most reflections from coming back. There are better solutions as well.

[http://www.holowiki.com/index.php?title ... _the_Laser](http://www.holowiki.com/index.php?title=Beam_Blocker#Back-Reflections_Re-Entering_the_Laser)
